holdout.rule: #1199 section 1a: LOCKED buoys are archived like every other, but the scorer reads none of them and every published table and printed line excludes them, keyed to the frozen LOCKED list by its SHA-256. Until locked_list is recorded, the scorer is collect-only (NOT_READ) and publishes nothing. fit_used buoys stay in this lane's indicative tables, tagged, and #1199's P1 excludes them.

rules.nearshore_eval: #1156 truth.select_stations: directional, 10-40 m, not USACE FRF Duck, not assimilated into the driving model, no unresolved harbour structure within 1 km. The first four are evaluated here; the harbour criterion is the nearshore lane's (gate 0.4), so no station carries the tag yet.
rules.regional_box:
(section 2a): per (model, set), a buoy's box is the regional box whose bounds contain it; if several do, the
one where the buoy lies farthest from the box edge (km: the shortest distance to any of the four edges, longitude scaled by
cos(lat)); ties go to the lexically smallest region_id. A buoy in no box has Tier A only (`no_regional_tier`).
rules.sheltered: sheltered = the station lies inside a named bay, sound, strait or channel, or in the lee of a named island chain or headland, as written per station in the pool file's `sheltered` map (the feature is recorded); absent = exposed
